citation: Zhang and Chen. Link Prediction Based on Graph Neural Networks
research_question: Can enclosing subgraphs transform link prediction into graph classification?
data_and_unit: Standard network benchmarks; candidate link subgraphs
negative_or_unlabelled_design: Sampled absent links treated as negatives
relevance_to_project: Defines the original SEAL framework and DRNL baseline
risk_or_gap: Original formulation and common implementations are primarily undirected
project_decision: Reproduce as the frozen conceptual and implementation baseline

citation: Chamberlain et al. Graph Neural Networks for Link Prediction with Subgraph Sketching
research_question: Can structural sketches retain subgraph-GNN expressiveness with much lower computational cost?
split_protocol: Benchmark train validation and test partitions
relevance_to_project: Provides a modern generic structural baseline and scalability reference
risk_or_gap: Designed around generic benchmarks rather than ecological direction and uncertain absences
project_decision: Run BUDDY on matched undirected projections as a secondary baseline

citation: Wang Yang and Zhang. Neural Common Neighbor with Completion for Link Prediction
research_question: Can completed common-neighbour structure improve prediction under graph incompleteness?
split_protocol: Benchmark train validation and test partitions
relevance_to_project: Motivates explicit treatment of structural incompleteness
risk_or_gap: Common-neighbour assumptions and benchmarks may not transfer to directed sparse food webs
project_decision: Use as conceptual literature; add as a model only if it resolves a prespecified baseline gap

citation: Poisot. Guidelines for the prediction of species interactions through binary classification
research_question: How should sparse species-interaction classifiers be trained and evaluated?
data_and_unit: Simulated ecological networks and classifier experiments
negative_or_unlabelled_design: Examines class imbalance and construction of training data
primary_metrics: Evaluation recommendations beyond accuracy and ROC-AUC
relevance_to_project: Directly governs metric choice and candidate construction
risk_or_gap: Guidance must be translated into directed and positive-unlabelled experiments
project_decision: Adopt ranking calibration and prevalence-aware metrics; keep ROC-AUC secondary

citation: Biton Puzis and Pilosof. Inductive link prediction facilitates the discovery of missing links and enables cross-community inference in ecological networks
research_question: Can models trained across communities predict links within unseen ecological networks?
data_and_unit: 538 bipartite ecological networks across four interaction types
negative_or_unlabelled_design: Unobserved interactions used according to the published ILP protocol
relevance_to_project: Establishes that ecological cross-network transfer is feasible and publishable at high impact
risk_or_gap: Focuses on bipartite interaction types rather than directed unipartite food webs and SEAL subgraphs
project_decision: Differentiate through directed trophic networks uncertainty and temporal validation

citation: Van Kleunen et al. Predicting missing links in food webs using stacked models and species traits
research_question: Can structural and trait predictors be optimally combined for directed food-web link prediction?
data_and_unit: The same global collection of 290 food webs
split_protocol: Five-fold cross-validation repeated five times within web
relevance_to_project: Most important domain-specific comparator; already covers direction traits structure and the 290 networks
risk_or_gap: Makes a simple trait-aware SEAL application insufficiently novel
project_decision: Reproduce the stacked method on matched splits and focus the new claim on transfer and uncertainty

citation: Kampe DeSisto and Dunson. Link prediction in ecological meta-networks under extreme taxonomic bias
research_question: How can link prediction account for occurrence uncertainty and taxonomically biased sampling?
negative_or_unlabelled_design: Latent true interactions with occurrence uncertainty
relevance_to_project: Provides a rigorous alternative to treating every unobserved pair as a negative
risk_or_gap: Different network type and a statistical latent-factor framework rather than subgraph GNNs
project_decision: Use to define bias scenarios and justify positive-unlabelled evaluation

citation: Habedank. A new perspective for revealing hidden interactions in ecological networks
research_question: How should predicted missing links also be interpreted from the perspective of affected nodes?
relevance_to_project: Suggests node-level ecological outputs beyond aggregate classifier performance
risk_or_gap: Single case study and not a modern learning benchmark
project_decision: Consider a node-priority supplementary analysis for DAPSTOM predictions

citation: Conformal network link prediction with false discovery rate control under unstructured missingness
research_question: Can multiple missing links be predicted while controlling false discoveries under unknown missingness?
negative_or_unlabelled_design: Treats missing links through an explicit uncertainty framework
relevance_to_project: Potential foundation for trustworthy ranked ecological predictions
risk_or_gap: Assumptions may not hold under ecological sampling bias and directed multi-network transfer
project_decision: Study during calibration design; adopt only after checking assumptions on Gateway and DAPSTOM
